lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还记得第一单那户翻修种植间的人家吗？他们又来问了！
lines.en: Remember the people renovating their growing room, our first order? They asked again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回那批用得怎么样？
lines.en: How did the last lot work out?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 验收过了，一件都没退。这回他们先问下一批什么时候能看，还特意问是不是还由我经手。
lines.en: It passed inspection. Not one return. This time they asked when they could see the next lot, and specifically whether I'd still be handling it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么回的？
lines.en: What did you tell them?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先问他们要什么、什么时候要。我又没答应每回都能变出货来。
lines.en: I asked what they needed and when. I haven't promised to conjure it up every time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就等他们的单子。
lines.en: Then wait for the list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。……以前别人来找我，多半是想托我打听母亲的事。这一回，他们先问的是我。
lines.en: Mm. ...People used to approach me mostly to ask my mother something. This time, they asked for me first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这是你自己挣来的。
lines.en: You earned that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道。所以才第一个来告诉你。
lines.en: I know. That's why I wanted to tell you first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 卷帘门刚拉起来，你就看见她站在外面。听见动静，她往前走了一步，手还攥着包带。
lines.en: As the shutter rises, you see her waiting outside. She steps towards the sound, still gripping her bag strap.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么早？
lines.en: This early?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲接出来了！我见到她了，先把她安顿好，就赶过来了。
lines.en: My mother is out. I've seen her. I got her settled, then came straight here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本来想等你开了门再来……还是来早了。
lines.en: I meant to wait until you opened... Still came too early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来，从头说。
lines.en: Come in. Start at the beginning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 卷帘门刚拉起来，你就看见她站在外面。听见动静，她往前走了一步，手还攥着包带。
lines.en: As the shutter rises, you see her waiting outside. She steps towards the sound, still gripping her bag strap.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么早？
lines.en: This early?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲安全转出来了！我刚从她那儿过来。
lines.en: My mother has been moved to safety. I've just come from seeing her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本来想等你开了门再来……还是来早了。
lines.en: I meant to wait until you opened... Still came too early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来，从头说。
lines.en: Come in. Start at the beginning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 最后一位客人已经离开。你正要关上店门，熟悉的声音却从门口传来。
lines.en: The last customer has gone. Just as you are about to close up, a familiar voice comes from the doorway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天轮到我来接你了。
lines.en: Today it's my turn to pick you up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她换回上层区的正装，站在门口，等你先开口。
lines.en: Dressed for the Upper Level, she stands in the doorway and waits for you to speak.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: ……这身是穿给谁看的？
lines.en: ...Who are you wearing that for?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先看。看够了再问。
lines.en: Look first. Ask when you've had enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算了，再多给你看一会儿。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'll give you another moment.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今晚是什么场合？
lines.en: What's the occasion tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面有一场晚会。请柬上有一栏，要填同行人的名字。
lines.en: There's a party upstairs. The invitation has a space for a companion's name.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那一栏很难填？
lines.en: A difficult space to fill?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想被填进去的人太多了。有人送花，有人给我留座位，还有人提醒我，带一位“合适的男伴”，对以后的生意有好处。
lines.en: Too many people want their name there. Flowers, reserved seats, and reminders that a 'suitable companion' would be good for business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就是上回你推掉的那张饭桌？
lines.en: Including that table you turned down last time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那张也在里面。
lines.en: That one too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把请柬放在柜台上，推到你面前。同行人那一栏空着。
lines.en: She lays the invitation on the counter and slides it towards you. The companion's space is blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟他们提过你。可总有人以为，我只是客客气气地谢一谢出过钱的老板。
lines.en: I've told them about you. But some still think I'm only being polite to the shopkeeper who put up the money.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以今晚要把话说清楚。
lines.en: So tonight you intend to make it clear.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我也想跟你跳支舞！别光听前半句。
lines.en: I also want a dance with you. Don't only hear the first part.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这身衣服？
lines.en: And these clothes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 穿件干净的外套就行。我带的是你，又不是你的衣服。
lines.en: A clean coat will do. I'm bringing you, not your clothes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你自己填。
lines.en: Fill it in yourself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你写下自己的名字。她看了一眼，合上请柬，朝你伸出手。
lines.en: You write your name. She glances at it, closes the invitation and holds out her hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 走吧。今晚的时间，归我了。
lines.en: Come on. Tonight, your time is mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场，我自己去了。同行人那一栏，我一直空着。
lines.en: I went to that party on my own. Left the companion's space blank.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有人问吗？
lines.en: Did anyone ask?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 问了。我说他店里走不开。……下回你要是还走不开，我就直接去店里把你拎走！
lines.en: They did. I said he couldn't leave the shop. ...Next time you're stuck there, I'll come and carry you out myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 报纸写到我们了！“神秘男伴”——我明明告诉他们你是干什么的了。
lines.en: We're in the paper. 'Mysterious companion'—I told them exactly what you do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他们大概还没来过我的店。
lines.en: They probably haven't visited my shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就让他们来。来问价的时候，你照常算。
lines.en: Then let them come. Quote your usual prices.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也照常？
lines.en: You too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 生意照常。别的，等客人走了再说。
lines.en: Business as usual. The rest can wait until the customers leave.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回说好，下一场要把时间留给我。现在关门了，能陪我走了吗？
lines.en: You promised me the next party. The shop is closing now. Can you come with me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天的时间留出来了吗？请柬我带来了，名字还是你自己填。
lines.en: Kept the time free today? I've brought the invitation. You still have to write your own name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场没赶上。这次是另一场，请柬我带来了。现在能陪我去了吧？
lines.en: We missed that party. This is another one; I've brought the invitation. Can you come with me this time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……好，那这场我自己去。你也早点休息，别又忙到半夜。
lines.en: ...All right. I will go on my own. Get some rest yourself. Do not work until midnight again.
